title: "GC/MS RRF distributions and uncertainty factors"
subtitle: "Censored Normal, log-normal and gamma fits and UF values for published GC/MS RRF databases (Christiaens 2020, Norwood 2012, Zdravkovic 2018, Kritikos 2023, Deng 2026), plus UF-only entries computed from published mean/RSD for Jenke 2022, Jordi 2020 and Jenke 2024. Structure follows RRFdistcens_figure4.qmd."
format: html
editor: visual
---

# Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(fitdistrplus)
library(patchwork)
```

# Data

RRF values were read from the source PDFs and are inlined below as vectors:

- Christiaens 2020 — Table I excerpt, 40 compounds, RRF against 2-fluorobiphenyl.
- Norwood 2012 — Table 5.1, 31 compounds, two series against two internal standards: 2-fluorobiphenyl (published mean 0.623, SD 0.270, %RSD 43.3) and p-terphenyl-d14 (published mean 0.473, SD 0.197, %RSD 41.6). Both are reproduced by the extraction and both are fitted below.
- Zdravkovic 2018 — Table 4 overall mean RRF (n = 32 replicates per compound). Only the 97 non-derivatized ("As is") compounds are kept; the 57 TMS/TFA-derivatized compounds are excluded, since their RRFs reflect the derivative, not the native analyte.
- Kritikos 2023 — the GC-MS subset only (42 compounds, including the IS itself, dodec-1-ene, RRF = 1.0; RRF against dodec-1-ene). The paper also reports LC-MS positive/negative data, which is out of scope for this GC/MS file.
- Deng 2026 — Table IV, the 13 GC-MS compounds (aromatic/alcohol subset) for which a measured RRF is reported alongside the ML-predicted value. This is the only place in the paper individual measured GC/MS RRFs are given; the paper does not state a single named surrogate for these measurements. The full 49-compound out-of-sample set (Table II) reports predicted concentration and % accuracy only, not RRF, so it cannot be used here.
- FDA CLAP (Chemicals List for Analytical Performance) — the 92-compound GC-MS reference standard list (`processed_data/GCMS.xlsx`), including the IS itself (2,4-di-tert-butylphenol, RRF = 1.0), RRF against 2,4-di-tert-butylphenol, reported at three spiking levels (5, 10, 20 µg/mL). All three levels are kept as separate series, following the same rationale as the two Norwood series above. 0 = not detected; these are left-censored at the LOQ like everywhere else in this file.

Three further datasets report only summary statistics (mean, SD/RSD, n) for their GC/MS RRF population, not individual compound values, so they cannot be Turnbull-fitted and are included in the Uncertainty Factors section only, using their published mean and RSD directly:

- Jenke 2022 — Table II, Nelson GC/MS RRF database, "all compounds" row (n = 1193, mean = 0.524, RSD = 66.8%, RRF against 2-fluorobiphenyl). Table III only lists an unrepresentative 25-compound low-responder excerpt, not the full database.
- Jordi 2020 — Table 1, normalized GC-MS RRF distribution (n = 128 detected of 217 tested, mean = 1.0 by normalization, RSD = 52%, RRF against decane).
- Jenke 2024 (JenkeC2024) — Table 1, expanded Nelson GC/MS RRF database, "All Data" column (n = 3215, mean = 0.5433, RSD = 61.72%, RRF against 2-fluorobiphenyl).

Each database uses its own internal standard/surrogate, so the UF values below are read per dataset and are not pooled across datasets. The surrogate used by each dataset is listed as a column in the Uncertainty Factors table.

**Censoring convention (Turnbull NPMLE):** values that are 0 or at/below the LOQ (0.001) are treated as left-censored at the LOQ rather than dropped.

```{r}
loq <- 0.001            # limit of quantification used as right-bound for censored obs.
gamma_params <- data.frame()
norm_params  <- data.frame()
aic_params   <- data.frame()

# Helper: build the two-column censored data frame for fitdistcens
# Detected (v > loq)  → left = right = v        (exact observation)
# N.D. / BDL / NA     → left = NA, right = loq   (left-censored)
make_cens <- function(v) {
  v <- as.numeric(v)
  data.frame(
    left  = ifelse(is.na(v) | v <= loq, NA,  v),
    right = ifelse(is.na(v) | v <= loq, loq, v)
  )
}
```

# GC/MS Analysis

## Christiaens 2020

```{r}
cens_data <- make_cens(chri)

set.seed(123)
fnorm  <- fitdistcens(cens_data, "norm")
flnorm <- fitdistcens(cens_data, "lnorm")
fgamma <- fitdistcens(cens_data, "gamma")

summary(fnorm); summary(flnorm); summary(fgamma)

aic_params <- rbind(aic_params, data.frame(
  Dataset = "Christiaens 2020",
  Normal = AIC(fnorm), LogNormal = AIC(flnorm), Gamma = AIC(fgamma)
))

gamma_params <- rbind(gamma_params, data.frame(
  Dataset = "Christiaens 2020",
  shape = fgamma$estimate["shape"], rate = fgamma$estimate["rate"]
))

norm_params <- rbind(norm_params, data.frame(
  Dataset = "Christiaens 2020",
  mean = fnorm$estimate["mean"], sd = fnorm$estimate["sd"]
))

RRF_df <- data.frame(RRF = cens_data$right)
p_fit <- ggplot(RRF_df, aes(x = RRF)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 20,
                 fill = "lightgray", color = "white", na.rm = TRUE) +
  stat_function(fun = dnorm,   args = list(mean  = fnorm$estimate["mean"],    sd    = fnorm$estimate["sd"]),       aes(color = "Normal"),     linewidth = 1) +
  stat_function(fun = dlnorm,  args = list(meanlog = flnorm$estimate["meanlog"], sdlog = flnorm$estimate["sdlog"]), aes(color = "Log-normal"), linewidth = 1) +
  stat_function(fun = dgamma,  args = list(shape = fgamma$estimate["shape"],  rate  = fgamma$estimate["rate"]),   aes(color = "Gamma"),      linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Distribution",
                     values = c("Normal" = "darkblue", "Log-normal" = "darkred", "Gamma" = "darkgreen")) +
  labs(title = "Christiaens 2020: Fit Comparison", x = "RRF", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()
p_fit

qq_norm  <- ggplot(RRF_df, aes(sample = RRF)) +
  stat_qq(distribution = qnorm,  dparams = list(mean = fnorm$estimate["mean"], sd = fnorm$estimate["sd"]), alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_qq_line(distribution = qnorm, dparams = list(mean = fnorm$estimate["mean"], sd = fnorm$estimate["sd"]), color = "darkblue", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Normal Q-Q", x = "Theoretical quantiles (RRF)", y = "Sample quantiles (RRF)") + theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

qq_lnorm <- ggplot(RRF_df, aes(sample = RRF)) +
  stat_qq(distribution = qlnorm, dparams = list(meanlog = flnorm$estimate["meanlog"], sdlog = flnorm$estimate["sdlog"]), alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_qq_line(distribution = qlnorm, dparams = list(meanlog = flnorm$estimate["meanlog"], sdlog = flnorm$estimate["sdlog"]), color = "darkred", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Log-normal Q-Q", x = "Theoretical quantiles (RRF)", y = "Sample quantiles (RRF)") + theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

qq_gamma <- ggplot(RRF_df, aes(sample = RRF)) +
  stat_qq(distribution = qgamma, dparams = list(shape = fgamma$estimate["shape"], rate = fgamma$estimate["rate"]), alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_qq_line(distribution = qgamma, dparams = list(shape = fgamma$estimate["shape"], rate = fgamma$estimate["rate"]), color = "darkgreen", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Gamma Q-Q", x = "Theoretical quantiles (RRF)", y = "Sample quantiles (RRF)") + theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

(qq_norm + qq_lnorm + qq_gamma)
```

```{r}
flnorm <- fitdistcens(cens_data, "lnorm")
```

```{r}
cens_data <- make_cens(clap5)
det <- cens_data$right[!is.na(cens_data$left)]
m <- mean(det); s <- sd(det); cv2 <- (s/m)^2

set.seed(123)
fnorm  <- fitdistcens(cens_data, "norm",
                       start = list(mean = m, sd = s),
                       optim.method = "L-BFGS-B", lower = c(mean = 0, sd = 1e-4))
flnorm <- fitdistcens(cens_data, "lnorm",
                       start = list(meanlog = log(m) - 0.5*log(1+cv2), sdlog = sqrt(log(1+cv2))),
```

## Normal parameters

Mean and SD from the censored Normal fit per dataset. These are the parameters used when the RRFs are treated as normally distributed (the assumption behind the ISO 10993-18 UF formula).

```{r}
norm_params
```

## AIC model comparison

AIC for the three censored fits (Normal, log-normal, gamma) per dataset (all nine with raw compound-level data). The `Best` column is computed directly from the fitted AIC values, not assumed.

```{r}
aic_params$Best <- c("Normal", "LogNormal", "Gamma")[apply(aic_params[, c("Normal","LogNormal","Gamma")], 1, which.min)]
aic_params[, c("Normal","LogNormal","Gamma")] <- round(aic_params[, c("Normal","LogNormal","Gamma")], 2)
aic_params
```

```{r}
aic_params %>%
  dplyr::select(Dataset, Normal, LogNormal, Gamma) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Dataset, names_to = "Distribution", values_to = "AIC") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Dataset, y = AIC, fill = Distribution)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Normal" = "darkblue", "LogNormal" = "darkred", "Gamma" = "darkgreen")) +
  labs(title = "AIC by dataset and distribution (lower = better fit)", x = NULL, y = "AIC") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))
```

# Uncertainty Factors

Three UF forms are computed from the detected RRFs (v \> loq) of each dataset:

- 1 / μ
- UF (ISO 10993-18:2022) = 1 / (1 − RSD)
- UF (corrected) = 1 / \[μ (1 − RSD)\]

where μ is the mean RRF and RSD = σ / μ. The corrected form adds back the 1/μ factor that the ISO form omits (manuscript Eq. 7). The ISO and corrected forms are undefined when RSD ≥ 1; those cells are set to NA.

For Jenke 2022, Jordi 2020 and Jenke 2024, mean and RSD are taken directly from the source (see Data section) rather than computed from raw values, since no individual compound-level data is available.

```{r}
surrogates <- c(
  "Christiaens 2020"                = "2-fluorobiphenyl",
  "Norwood 2012 (2-FB)"             = "2-fluorobiphenyl",
  "Norwood 2012 (p-terphenyl-d14)"  = "p-terphenyl-d14",
  "Zdravkovic 2018"                 = "acetophenone-d5",
  "Kritikos 2023"                   = "dodec-1-ene",
  "Deng 2026"                       = "not stated",
  "CLAP 5 µg/mL"                    = "2,4-di-tert-butylphenol",
  "CLAP 10 µg/mL"                   = "2,4-di-tert-butylphenol",
  "CLAP 20 µg/mL"                   = "2,4-di-tert-butylphenol",
  "Jenke 2022"                      = "2-fluorobiphenyl",
  "Jordi 2020"                      = "decane",
  "Jenke 2024"                      = "2-fluorobiphenyl"
)

gcms_list <- list("Christiaens 2020"                = chri,
                  "Norwood 2012 (2-FB)"            = norw_fb,
                  "Norwood 2012 (p-terphenyl-d14)" = norw_tph,
                  "Zdravkovic 2018"                = zdra,
                  "Kritikos 2023"                  = kritikos,
                  "Deng 2026"                       = deng,
                  "CLAP 5 µg/mL"                    = clap5,
                  "CLAP 10 µg/mL"                   = clap10,
                  "CLAP 20 µg/mL"                   = clap20)

# CLAP rows use every value (non-detects as 0, IS included) so n = 92, per explicit
# instruction. Every other dataset keeps the file's default detected-only (v > loq) convention.
use_all_values <- c("CLAP 5 µg/mL", "CLAP 10 µg/mL", "CLAP 20 µg/mL")

gcms_uf <- data.frame()
for (nm in names(gcms_list)) {
  x <- as.numeric(gcms_list[[nm]])
  if (!(nm %in% use_all_values)) x <- x[!is.na(x) & x > loq]
  mu  <- mean(x); s <- sd(x); rsd <- s / mu; ok <- rsd < 1
  gcms_uf <- rbind(gcms_uf, data.frame(
    Dataset      = nm,
    Surrogate    = surrogates[[nm]],
    n            = length(x),
    mean         = round(mu, 3),
    sd           = round(s, 3),
    RSD          = round(rsd, 3),
    one_mean      = round(1 / mu, 2),
    UF_ISO       = ifelse(ok, round(1 / (1 - rsd), 2), NA),
    UF_corrected = ifelse(ok, round(1 / (mu * (1 - rsd)), 2), NA)
  ))
}

# Datasets with published summary statistics only (no raw compound-level RRF values).
summary_only <- data.frame(
  Dataset = c("Jenke 2022", "Jordi 2020", "Jenke 2024"),
  n       = c(1193,          128,           3215),
  mean    = c(0.524,         1.0,           0.5433),
  sd      = c(0.351,         0.52,          0.3353)
)
summary_only$RSD          <- round(summary_only$sd / summary_only$mean, 3)
summary_only$Surrogate    <- surrogates[summary_only$Dataset]
summary_only$one_mean      <- round(1 / summary_only$mean, 2)
ok                          <- summary_only$RSD < 1
summary_only$UF_ISO       <- ifelse(ok, round(1 / (1 - summary_only$RSD), 2), NA)
summary_only$UF_corrected <- ifelse(ok, round(1 / (summary_only$mean * (1 - summary_only$RSD)), 2), NA)

gcms_uf <- rbind(gcms_uf, summary_only[, names(gcms_uf)])
gcms_uf
```

```{r}
gcms_uf %>%
  dplyr::select(Dataset, one_mean, UF_ISO, UF_corrected) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Dataset, names_to = "UF_type", values_to = "UF") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Dataset, y = UF, fill = UF_type)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.na(UF), "NA", format(UF, nsmall = 2))),
            position = position_dodge(0.8), vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "UF form",
                    values = c("one_mean" = "grey", "UF_ISO" = "darkred", "UF_corrected" = "darkgreen")) +
  labs(title = "GC/MS uncertainty factors by dataset", x = NULL, y = "UF") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1))
```
